_comment: Lines for who you were before the fall (flag origin_<id>) and for a run that remembers an earlier ending (flag echo, echo_<ending>).

lines.text: You coil a line right. Over, under, never round the elbow. Somebody taught you properly.
Most who fall in want out. You don't seem to mind. I don't know what to do with that.
Had a dream. You and me, wiring a valve shut. Woke up with copper on my hands. I don't like dreams.
